literal: Like a madman becoming intoxicated indeed is a fool if he obtains a possession in his hand.
translation: A fool obtaining a possession in his hand is like a madman becoming intoxicated.
modern: மனநலம் குன்றிய ஒருவன் மதுவருந்தி வெறி கொள்வதைப் போன்றது, அறிவிலி தன் கையில் ஏதேனும் ஒரு செல்வத்தைப் பெறுவது ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares a fool who acquires wealth to a madman who gets drunk. A person who is already mentally unstable (மையல் ஒருவன்) will lose all remaining restraint and act wildly if they consume alcohol (களித்தற்று). Similarly, a fool (பேதை), who already lacks wisdom and self-control, becomes completely reckless and arrogant when they acquire a possession (உடைமை) in their hand. The analogy highlights how sudden fortune does not improve a fool, but rather amplifies their inherent foolishness and makes them dangerous.
